baseline: Frozen v2 CART procedure plus ETF buy/hold and causal always-long volatility-managed reference
primary_objective: Net daily Sharpe on identical dates/costs; zero cash/risk-free convention retained for continuity until a separately declared excess-return/cash-yield sensitivity is qualified
historical_scope: All pre-2024 history has now been inspected and used for exploratory hypotheses; current results are not prospective confirmation.
research_shortlist_for_discussion: Combined payoff/context procedure as a global candidate, not per-ETF outer-winner selection
Simple trend/momentum controls and causal passive volatility management
Payoff-buffer and recency/risk-normalization ideas only as separately frozen hypotheses
before_unsealing: Agree a small global or explicitly instrument-specific candidate set and fixed success criteria
Freeze data availability, source/config/environment hashes, execution, cash yield and cost conventions
Qualify direct market yields, commodity carry and point-in-time sector fundamentals before adding them
Reconcile vendor total-return actions, especially XLF2016
Use reserved results once for confirmation; any inspected period cannot become pristine again
Keep all15 accounts independent with no portfolio, puts, leverage or live execution
planned_confirmation_measures: Net Sharpe delta versus the incumbent and passive controls
Predeclared uncertainty/multiplicity treatment; no automatic deployment from historical p-values
